hook_text: Started a walking club. It grew.

song.title: Come Walk With Me
song.style: English, stomping folk-rock march with banjo, big drums and gang vocals, warm friendly male lead vocal, slightly raspy, 120 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Monday morning, just me and my shoes
Tuesday came a dog with nothing to lose
Wednesday brought the baker and her son
Thursday, half the town had come

[Chorus]
Infinite stroll, there's no finish line
Nobody's tracking, everybody's fine
Infinite stroll, come walk with me
No feed, no ads, just company

[Verse]
Friday we were singing down the lane
Saturday we laughed right through the rain
Sunday every porch had someone new
There's always room, and a shirt for you

[Chorus]
Infinite stroll, there's no finish line
Over the hills and past the pines
Infinite stroll, come walk with me
No feed, no ads, just company

shots.prompt: {moss} leads a huge happy crowd of walkers over the top of a green hill toward the camera, waving. Wide shot, static. Bright morning sun.
{moss} walks alone down a quiet path at dawn, his raincoat open over a cream t-shirt. The camera tracks backward. Soft early light.
A scruffy brown dog trots out of a hedge and falls into step beside {moss}, tail wagging. Low tracking shot. Morning light.
a tall baker woman with a flour-dusted blue apron and her small son join {moss} on the path, the boy holding a warm loaf. Static medium shot. Warm morning light.

A cream t-shirt with a simple illustration of rolling green hills and a winding path shaped like an infinity loop hangs on a wooden hanger against a sunny cream wall, gently swaying in a breeze from an open window. Soft daylight, warm shadows. Static close-up.
A crowd of walkers sings arm in arm down a country lane behind {moss}. The camera tracks backward. Golden light.
{moss} and the walkers laugh through a rain shower under colorful umbrellas. Static wide shot. Soft grey light with bright umbrellas.
Neighbors on their porches wave and step down to join {moss} and the walking crowd. The camera tracks sideways. Late afternoon gold.
{moss} sits on a hilltop with all the walkers watching the sunset, the dog asleep at his feet. The camera slowly pulls back. Peach and gold, calm.

endcard.line1: No feed. No ads. No end.

caption: Moss started a walking club in his Infinite Stroll tee. Monday it was just him. Sunday it was the whole town.
